note: The three conditions as a parameter set for the engine's materials and for the wear layer of unit 4.5 (production/cloud-week/2d/wear/, target production/cloud-week/targets/wear/target.json): roughness is set in each house's door material; the neglected door carries the eroded notch as geometry (leaf_notch_bare); everything else is the layer's masks. No vertex colour is written: a leaf is a few large flat faces, and a gradient across them would not carry a splash band.
not_covered_by_the_layer: crazing in 2 to 4 mm cells: the layer's paint_flake crazing cells are 0.14 to 0.23 m (render); a timber-door tile is owed
kick marks and boot prints on a bottom rail: not a kind of the layer (the nearest is wall_foot_splash)
a letter plate's bright polish ring: not a kind (the layer's handle_wear is a dark grease halo); owed as a small brightening mask in the brass's own material
rot as geometry (the eroded notch): the layer is a texture, so the notch is a build parameter of the door

kept.chips: 0 to 2 chips of 8 to 15 mm on the leaf's lower arrises
kept.bottom_rail: clean; a dark splash band to 0.24 m only
kept.kick_marks: 0 to 2 scuffs, 20 to 40 mm, on the bottom rail
kept.polish: the brass is polished: a bright ring 12 mm wide round the letter plate's flap and the knob (kept bright), the rest dull gold
kept.frame: white, sound, a yellowing at the foot

tired.crazing: cells 2 to 4 mm over 30 per cent of the leaf (P2's)
tired.chips: 4 to 8 chips of 10 to 40 mm on arrises and the mouldings' lower lips, bare wood or undercoat showing
tired.bottom_rail: darkened by splash to 0.33 m, a paint loss of 20 per cent on the rail
tired.kick_marks: 3 to 6 scuffs and one boot print band 60 mm high at the lock side
tired.polish: brass dull; a brighter ring where the flap is pushed (10 to 14 mm wide), a dark grease halo 0.17 m round the handle (handle_wear)
tired.frame: yellowed, a hairline crack at the stop's foot

neglected.crazing: cells 2 to 4 mm over the whole leaf (P2's old door)
neglected.chips: 12 to 20 chips and two sheets of 80 to 250 mm off the rail and stile feet, grey bare timber below
neglected.bottom_rail: rotted: an eroded notch 25 mm high and 60 to 200 mm wide, 3 mm deep, in the lower arris at the hinge side, bare grey wood, a soft dark wet stain to 0.5 m
neglected.kick_marks: 8 to 15 scuffs and dents, a split 120 mm long in the bottom panel's lower edge
neglected.polish: brass dark and green-brown; the plate's flap rubbed bright in a ring 10 mm wide only where fingers push; no polish elsewhere
neglected.frame: peeling down to a darker undercoat, a dirty foot

notch.side: the hinge side's end of the bottom edge
